Description: Shift play triangle 1-2px right of mathematical center for perceived centering
Example_Good: transform: translateX(1px) on the triangle SVG
Example_Bad: Centered mathematically (looks visually off-center)

Description: Nudge icon -1px vertically for optical centering next to text
Example_Good: position: relative; top: -1px on the icon element
Example_Bad: vertical-align: middle alone (often still looks off)

Description: Extra horizontal padding compensates for the visual narrowing of rounded ends
Example_Good: px-6 py-2.5 — text breathes inside the pill shape
Example_Bad: px-4 py-2 — text feels cramped against rounded edges

Description: First and last items need extra padding to not feel cramped against container edges
Example_Good: first:pt-2 last:pb-2 on list items
Example_Bad: Uniform padding — top/bottom items feel squeezed

Description: All spacing derived from a 4px or 8px base unit eliminates arbitrary values
Example_Good: gap-2 (8px) / gap-4 (16px) / gap-6 (24px) — predictable scale
Example_Bad: gap: 13px / margin: 17px — arbitrary values with no system

Description: More whitespace between sections signals premium quality and improves scanning
Example_Good: py-24 to py-32 between major page sections
Example_Bad: py-8 between sections — content feels cramped and cheap

Description: Slightly more padding at bottom than top gives visual weight and grounding
Example_Good: pt-6 pb-8 — card feels anchored and balanced
Example_Bad: p-6 all around — card floats with no visual weight

Description: Related elements closer together / unrelated further apart (Gestalt proximity)
Example_Good: gap-2 between label and input / gap-6 between form groups
Example_Bad: Uniform gap-4 everywhere — no grouping hierarchy

Description: Mute surrounding elements instead of shouting the focused one for cleaner hierarchy
Example_Good: text-gray-400 for secondary / text-gray-900 for primary — quiet hierarchy
Example_Bad: text-blue-600 font-bold text-xl for focus element — too loud

Description: 60% dominant background / 30% secondary surfaces / 10% accent for CTAs and highlights
Example_Good: Background 60% / content cards 30% / CTA buttons 10% accent
Example_Bad: Equal distribution of 3 bright colors — visual noise

Description: Low-opacity borders add refinement without harsh lines that segment the design
Example_Good: border border-black/5 or border-white/10 — barely visible structure
Example_Bad: border border-gray-300 — harsh line that visually cuts the layout

Description: Green=success / yellow=warning / red=error / blue=info across entire product
Example_Good: Consistent semantic colors in alerts / badges / toasts / form states
Example_Bad: Red badge for new notifications (red = error confusion)

Description: Combine translateY with shadow increase for a realistic lifting effect on hover
Example_Good: hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200
Example_Bad: hover:opacity-80 only — flat and unengaging

Description: Subtle scale down on active/press gives satisfying tactile feedback
Example_Good: active:scale-[0.97] transition-transform duration-75
Example_Bad: active:opacity-50 — feels broken not pressed

Description: Sequential delay for list items creates a natural cascade reveal animation
Example_Good: delay = index * 30ms, max 300ms total cascade
Example_Bad: All items appear simultaneously — no visual rhythm

Description: Offset outline with semi-transparent brand color for accessible and attractive focus
Example_Good: outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-blue-500/40
Example_Bad: Default browser dotted outline — ugly and inconsistent

Description: Animate dropdown from trigger position for spatial continuity
Example_Good: transform-origin: top right; scale(0.95)→scale(1) opacity(0)→opacity(1)
Example_Bad: Fade in from center of viewport — no spatial relationship

Description: Elements should animate out (not just disappear) for spatial continuity
Example_Good: opacity-0 scale-95 transition-all duration-150 on unmount
Example_Bad: Element instantly removed from DOM — jarring disappearance

Description: Tighten headings for density; leave body at default for readability
Example_Good: tracking-tight (-0.025em) for h1-h3 headings
Example_Bad: Default tracking on all text — headings feel loose and airy

Description: Use weight and color for hierarchy before reaching for larger font sizes
Example_Good: text-base font-semibold text-gray-900 vs text-base text-gray-500 for hierarchy
Example_Bad: text-3xl vs text-base — size-only hierarchy is clumsy

Description: Use tabular-nums for aligned columns of numbers in data-heavy interfaces
Example_Good: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in tables / dashboards / pricing
Example_Bad: Proportional figures in data tables — columns do not align

Description: Larger text with lighter weight creates an editorial feel for testimonials and quotes
Example_Good: text-xl font-light text-gray-600 italic — elegant and readable
Example_Bad: text-base font-bold text-blue-600 — looks like an error message

Description: Limit line length to 45-75 characters for comfortable reading
Example_Good: max-w-prose (65ch) for text blocks and articles
Example_Bad: Full-width paragraphs — lines too long destroy readability

Description: Intentional size variation in grid creates visual hierarchy and interest
Example_Good: 1 large featured card (col-span-2) + 2 smaller cards
Example_Bad: 3 equal cards in a row — no hierarchy or focal point

Description: Generous empty space communicates luxury / confidence / premium quality
Example_Good: Large margins / generous padding / breathing room around CTAs
Example_Bad: Cramming every pixel with content — feels desperate and cluttered

Description: Cap page width to prevent ultra-wide layouts on large monitors
Example_Good: max-w-7xl mx-auto (1280px) — content stays readable on 4K
Example_Bad: Full-width layout — text stretches to 200+ characters per line

Description: Add shadow to sticky headers/navs only when scrolled to signal elevation
Example_Good: shadow-sm on scroll (via IntersectionObserver) — context-aware depth
Example_Bad: Permanent shadow on sticky nav — shadow visible at top feels wrong

Description: Use mass-stiffness-damping presets instead of linear durations
Example_Good: { mass: 0.8 stiffness: 280 damping: 24 } for modals
Example_Bad: transition: 0.3s ease

Description: Cap sequential stagger delays so users do not wait on content
Example_Good: index * 35ms capped at 210ms
Example_Bad: 50ms delay per item up to 20 items (too slow)

Description: Buttons should declare specific value and destination
Example_Good: 'Export transaction CSV' or 'Deploy to production'
Example_Bad: 'Submit' or 'Continue'

Description: Error messages must provide the solution and next step
Example_Good: 'Card declined by bank. Try a different card or call your issuer.'
Example_Bad: 'Payment failed. Please retry.'

Description: Skeletons must exactly match target height to prevent layout shift
Example_Good: h-10 w-full rounded-lg skeleton for inputs
Example_Bad: Generic spinner centered on blank screen

Principle: Proactive empty state with single CTA
Description: Empty states should guide the user to the first action
Example_Good: 'No webhooks yet' + 'Create first webhook' button
Example_Bad: 'No data available'

Description: Place critical mobile actions in the bottom 40% of viewport
Example_Good: Bottom-pinned floating bar with safe-area padding
Example_Bad: Primary CTA buried at top-right corner on mobile

Description: Desktop dialog should morph to bottom drawer on mobile
Example_Good: Drawer attached to bottom on <768px
Example_Bad: Fixed centered modal clipped by mobile keyboard

Description: Supply inputmode and enterkeyhint for native mobile keyboards
Example_Good: inputmode='decimal' for currency amounts
Example_Bad: Generic type='text' with no mobile hints
